title: Anchoring dates and Willard meeting Lee in 1949
summary: Willard asks Lee to tie events to dates and notes they met in 1949 at Eddie Beal's house.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: Well, it helps a little to get sort of --anchor it down so we can think of it in relationship to what else was going on. If we can, where we can.
I met you in about 1949 or '50. No, '49.
It was '49 when I met you.
Yes, I met you in '49. I associate it with Eddie Beal's house; everybody used to go to Eddie Beal's house and there used to be music in Eddie Beal's living room all the time.
All the time ... all the time, that's a fact. Well, if I can think of something else, I'll come back --but we'll go on to how I joined Nat in '53.
